description: This file defines the CustomHeadersHandler interface responsible for adding custom headers to HTTP requests in the Ditto gateway service. It includes an enum for request types and a method for appending headers asynchronously.

classes.name: CustomHeadersHandler
classes.description: Interface responsible for adding custom headers to requests.

methods.name: handleCustomHeaders
methods.description: Asynchronously appends custom headers to the default DittoHeaders and returns a new instance containing both default and custom headers.
